First quarter 2022 = six months 2022 (6) less second quarter 2022 (1) = 5. Inputs are printed in whole millions, so the result is approximate. The same document gives first quarter 2023 as 54 less 38 = 16, which agrees with the 16 printed as the prior-year column of the first-quarter 2024 release.
